name: recovery-kit
description: The printable and QR recovery kit of section 20 paragraph 12: the format and crypto profile version, the seed and its checksum, each configured service origin and the stable opaque bundle locator.
note: The seed below is the same test material as `kdf.json`, so the two documents agree about its checksum and its derived subkeys. A real seed is 256 random bits and is never a literal.

printed.description: What a person types, and what a QR code carries in byte mode. The two are the same bytes.
printed.seed_alphabet: Crockford base32, without I, L, O and U; reading accepts either case and maps I and L to 1 and O to 0.
